[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-a8[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Split bead state into a dedicated beads sidecar repository[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every SASE-managed project stores bead state in its own auto-cloned[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`<project>--beads` sidecar repository, seeded by `sase repo init` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with a generated README and infographic, lazily cloned by `sase [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bead` when absent, and adopted from the plans sidecar by a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reversible migration that has been run against every currently [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]enabled project.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]beads_sidecar_repo.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust core bead-store path recognition[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core: teach sase_core's bead-store path heuristics about the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`sase/repos/beads` sidecar root so design/plan reference resolution [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keeps working once bead state leaves the plans repo.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Beads sidecar README and infographic[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]guide[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guide: author the generated beads sidecar README template plus its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]GPT-image 1600x900 directory-map infographic and prompt record, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]split the guide-kind constant from the legacy directory-README constant.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Schema v3 store record and beads kind resolution[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]record[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]schema version 3, resolve `kind_root("beads")` and a per-kind repo root [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]from it, and keep schema-2 records resolving bead state to the plans [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sidecar unchanged.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Beads sidecar registration and inventory[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]config[dim] · [dim][/dim]after record[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]config: register `beads` as a managed sidecar role across defaults, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity, clone-dir mapping, repo inventory, `sase repo path`, doctor [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]storage checks, and the config schema, gating auto-clone on a recorded [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]beads sidecar.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Repo-root bead store layout[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]covering the beads dirname constant, gitignore patterns, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]conflict-resolver prefix handling, bead location resolution, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]project-root and bead-directory heuristics.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]vars, and commit attribution to the beads repository instead of the [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]`--ensure` materialize sidecars.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Beads sidecar initialization and adoption transaction[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
